card.name: Second digit of two-digit percentages
card.fires_on: The final digit of a two-digit number that is about to be followed by a percent sign, mostly in lists of drug-effect or adverse-event percentages.

modes.label: Interaction changes
modes.description: Last digit of a percent change in AUC or Cmax when another drug is given.
modes.example: increased C max and AUC of cilostazol by 18% and 2<<6>>% respectively

modes.label: Adverse event rates
modes.description: Last digit of the percent of patients with a side effect.
modes.example: Diarrhea occurred in 79% of patients, nausea in 65%, dyspepsia in 3<<8>>%, and vomiting in 34%.
